tasks.description: Sprint A batch 1 — TypeScript core + manifest
tasks.context:
## BATCH NOTE
Batch 1/4. Deliver: static-server.ts, public-mandates.ts, trust-signals-builder.ts, app.ts, aiax.json manifest.

CRITICAL for static-server.ts:
- Implement as a SIMPLE functional Express sub-router using express.Router() — NOT a class
- Export the router directly. No class-based wrappers. Keep under 150 lines.
- FINAL LINE OF FILE must be: export default router;
- Pattern: const router = express.Router(); ... router.get(...); ... export default router;

CRITICAL for trust-signals-builder.ts:
- Write the complete buildTrustSignals() or equivalent main function
- FINAL LINES must export the builder function, e.g.: export { buildTrustSignals }; or export default buildTrustSignals;
- Do NOT stop before the export

CRITICAL for app.ts:
- Mount the static-server router: app.use('/aiax', aiaxStaticRouter);
- The file must end with: export default app; or module.exports = app;
- Do NOT stop mid-route-registration

RULE FOR ALL FILES: The very last substantive line of every TypeScript file must be an export statement. Never end a file inside a function or before the export.

## Original task context
## Source of truth

Read ~/Documents/Invoica/docs/aiax-phase-2-scope.md FIRST. The 5 founder decisions in §'Decisions needed BEFORE swarm starts' are RESOLVED (see notes field of this sprint). Underlying plan: ~/kognai/workspace/godman-protocols/aiax/PHASE-2-INVOICA-PLAN.md. Spec: ~/kognai/workspace/godman-protocols/aiax/SPEC.md v0.1.0. Schema URLs: use GitHub raw on the kognai/workspace/godman-protocols repo until kognai.ai/aiax/schemas/... is live.

## Step 0 (FIRST HOUR, MANDATORY) — re-diff plan vs current code

The plan was authored 2026-05-21, 7 days BEFORE PACT-Helixa actually shipped (2026-05-28). Minor API drift is possible. Before writing any AIAX code:

1. Read the as-shipped backend/src/routes/mandates.ts. Confirm POST /v1/mandates/:id/dispute exists, requires { reason }, and returns the shape the plan assumes.
2. Read backend/src/routes/mandates.ts GET /v1/mandates/:id handler — confirm field names + auth wiring before designing the public redacted view.
3. Read backend/src/api/x402/*.ts (invoice + settle + tax handlers) — confirm request/response shapes the AIAX section examples will reference.
4. Read backend/src/services/mandate/anchor.ts — confirm anchor tx surfaced for trust_signals.
5. Read backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts (174 LOC) — DO NOT MODIFY IT. Confirm it's stdio + Claude Desktop. Sprint B will add a separate HTTP MCP server alongside it.
6. Document any drift in PR description before writing surface JSON.

## Deliverables (all paths sourced from scope §3.2 / §3.4)

### A. New public read endpoint (resolves founder-decision §1)

- backend/src/routes/public-mandates.ts: GET /v1/public/mandates/:id returns redacted view: state, mandate_hash, anchor_tx_hash, created_at, parties (just names + roles — NO emails). NO signatures. NO signing_secret. NO internal IDs other than the mandate id itself. NO context object. Mount in backend/src/app.ts BEFORE the authenticate middleware (public).
- Add a test that asserts the redaction: backend/src/routes/__tests__/public-mandates.test.ts must verify the response has NONE of: signatures, signing_secret, signedAt fingerprints, internal customer_id, raw context payload.

### B. Static surface (served from backend Express — backend is API-only, no Next.js public/)

Create backend/src/aiax/static-server.ts as an Express sub-router. Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 + ETag on every response. Mount on backend/src/app.ts BEFORE authenticate.

Files on disk:
- backend/public/.well-known/aiax.json (Tier 0 manifest, aiax_version: '0.1')
- backend/public/aiax/sections/create_invoice.json (Tier 1)
- backend/public/aiax/sections/settle_invoice.json (Tier 1)
- backend/public/aiax/sections/query_mandate.json (Tier 1) — example wires invoica_query_mandate to the new GET /v1/public/mandates/:id
- backend/public/aiax/sections/dispute_flow.json (Tier 1 — 6th section, resolves founder-decision §3; wraps POST /v1/mandates/:id/dispute, resolves founder-decision §2)
- backend/public/aiax/sections/pricing.json (Tier 1)
- backend/public/aiax/sections/trust_signals.json (Tier 1, regenerated nightly — see C)
- backend/public/aiax/reference/index.json (Tier 3)
- backend/public/aiax/reference/dispute-state-machine.md (Tier 3)

All JSON files MUST ajv-validate against the canonical schema (use GitHub raw URL until kognai.ai/aiax/schemas/* is live). Manifest's trust_signals.pact_endpoint must be the live PACT anchor URL.

### C. Trust-signals nightly rebuilder

- backend/src/aiax/trust-signals-builder.ts: reads SCORE table, counts DRS receipts, lists partnerships from a config constant. Rebuilds backend/public/aiax/sections/trust_signals.json on each run.
- Wire as a nightly PM2 cron in ecosystem.config.js (one new entry, name: aiax-trust-signals-builder, cron 03:00 UTC).

### D. CI ajv validation

- New GitHub Actions step (extend the existing backend CI workflow): on any PR that touches backend/public/aiax/** OR backend/public/.well-known/aiax.json, run `npx ajv validate` against the manifest schema for the well-known file and the section schema for each section JSON. Step must FAIL the PR if any JSON does not validate.

### E. Mintlify docs (docs-site/)

The docs-site nav grew 2026-05-28 (Helixa group). Rebase docs-site/docs.json against current main BEFORE adding the AIAX group.

Add a new 'AIAX' group in docs-site/docs.json BETWEEN 'Core Concepts' and 'Guides':
- docs-site/concepts/aiax.mdx (~250 LOC) — what AIAX is + composition with PACT (one-page summary, link to SPEC.md)
- docs-site/guides/aiax-discovery.mdx (~150 LOC) — wget-able agent walkthrough (curl /.well-known/aiax.json → curl a section → call a tool)
- The case-studies/aiax-benchmark.mdx page and api-reference/aiax-mcp.mdx page are Sprint B deliverables. Add the NAV ENTRIES in this sprint as 'Coming in v0.1' stubs, but DO NOT author them here.

### F. Kognai mirror coordination (resolves founder-decision §4)

- Open a tracking issue (or note in PR description) requesting Kognai swarm to add `kognai.ai/aiax-reference/invoica/` as a 301 → invoica.ai/aiax in their Next.js config. Single source of truth lives on invoica side; Kognai mirror is signal-only.
- Do NOT block PR merge on the Kognai-side redirect landing. This is a downstream join point.

## Coexistence rule (CRITICAL)

Do NOT touch backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts. It is the existing stdio MCP server for Claude Desktop (different transport, different toolset, different auth model). The new HTTP MCP server lands in Sprint B at backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts and they will coexist intentionally. Any PR that consolidates them will be rejected.

## Out of scope (do NOT pull forward)

- backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts (Sprint B)
- backend/src/aiax/tools.ts (Sprint B)
- aiax-mcp.test.ts (Sprint B)
- /aiax/benchmark.json (uploaded by Kognai-side harness, Sprint B publish step)
- CHANGELOG entry in ~/kognai/workspace/godman-protocols/aiax/CHANGELOG.md (Sprint B exit)
- Apache-2.0 LICENSE file already exists in @godman-protocols family — verify consistency only.
- No DB migrations.

## License

Apache-2.0 — consistent with @godman-protocols family.
tasks.acceptance: (1) `curl https://api.invoica.ai/.well-known/aiax.json` returns HTTP 200 with valid `aiax_version: "0.1"` and ajv-validates against the manifest schema. (2) All six Tier 1 sections (create_invoice, settle_invoice, query_mandate, dispute_flow, pricing, trust_signals) fetch at `/aiax/sections/<name>.json` with HTTP 200 and ajv-validate against the section schema. (3) `GET /v1/public/mandates/:id` returns HTTP 200 with a redacted view containing state, mandate_hash, anchor_tx_hash, created_at, parties (name + role only) and ZERO of: signatures, signing_secret, internal customer_id, raw context payload — asserted by public-mandates.test.ts. (4) Every static AIAX response carries `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` AND a non-empty ETag header — asserted by aiax-static-headers.test.ts. (5) The manifest's `trust_signals.pact_endpoint` returns HTTP 200 or 405 (POST-only). (6) `trust_signals.json` was regenerated by the nightly PM2 cron at least once and reflects live SCORE + DRS receipt counts. (7) CI ajv validation step fails any PR that introduces an invalid manifest or section JSON. (8) Mintlify AIAX group renders in docs-site between Core Concepts and Guides with concepts/aiax.mdx and guides/aiax-discovery.mdx live. (9) backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts has ZERO modifications in this PR — verified by git diff. (10) PR description documents any drift discovered in the Step 0 re-diff and includes the Kognai-side 301 coordination request. (11) No DB migrations introduced. (12) Apache-2.0 license header consistency confirmed.

## Step 0 (FIRST HOUR, MANDATORY) — re-diff plan vs current code

The plan was authored 2026-05-21, 7 days BEFORE PACT-Helixa actually shipped (2026-05-28). Minor API drift is possible. Before writing any AIAX code:

1. Read the as-shipped backend/src/routes/mandates.ts. Confirm POST /v1/mandates/:id/dispute exists, requires { reason }, and returns the shape the plan assumes.
2. Read backend/src/routes/mandates.ts GET /v1/mandates/:id handler — confirm field names + auth wiring before designing the public redacted view.
3. Read backend/src/api/x402/*.ts (invoice + settle + tax handlers) — confirm request/response shapes the AIAX section examples will reference.

5. Read backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts (174 LOC) — DO NOT MODIFY IT. Confirm it's stdio + Claude Desktop. Sprint B will add a separate HTTP MCP server alongside it.

## Deliverables (all paths sourced from scope §3.2 / §3.4)

### A. New public read endpoint (resolves founder-decision §1)

- backend/src/routes/public-mandates.ts: GET /v1/public/mandates/:id returns redacted view: state, mandate_hash, anchor_tx_hash, created_at, parties (just names + roles — NO emails). NO signatures. NO signing_secret. NO internal IDs other than the mandate id itself. NO context object. Mount in backend/src/app.ts BEFORE the authenticate middleware (public).
- Add a test that asserts the redaction: backend/src/routes/__tests__/public-mandates.test.ts must verify the response has NONE of: signatures, signing_secret, signedAt fingerprints, internal customer_id, raw context payload.

### B. Static surface (served from backend Express — backend is API-only, no Next.js public/)

Create backend/src/aiax/static-server.ts as an Express sub-router. Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 + ETag on every response. Mount on backend/src/app.ts BEFORE authenticate.

Files on disk:
- backend/public/.well-known/aiax.json (Tier 0 manifest, aiax_version: '0.1')
- backend/public/aiax/sections/create_invoice.json (Tier 1)
- backend/public/aiax/sections/settle_invoice.json (Tier 1)

All JSON files MUST ajv-validate against the canonical schema (use GitHub raw URL until kognai.ai/aiax/schemas/* is live). Manifest's trust_signals.pact_endpoint must be the live PACT anchor URL.

### C. Trust-signals nightly rebuilder

- backend/src/aiax/trust-signals-builder.ts: reads SCORE table, counts DRS receipts, lists partnerships from a config constant. Rebuilds backend/public/aiax/sections/trust_signals.json on each run.
- Wire as a nightly PM2 cron in ecosystem.config.js (one new entry, name: aiax-trust-signals-builder, cron 03:00 UTC).

### D. CI ajv validation

- New GitHub Actions step (extend the existing backend CI workflow): on any PR that touches backend/public/aiax/** OR backend/public/.well-known/aiax.json, run `npx ajv validate` against the manifest schema for the well-known file and the section schema for each section JSON. Step must FAIL the PR if any JSON does not validate.

### E. Mintlify docs (docs-site/)

The docs-site nav grew 2026-05-28 (Helixa group). Rebase docs-site/docs.json against current main BEFORE adding the AIAX group.

Add a new 'AIAX' group in docs-site/docs.json BETWEEN 'Core Concepts' and 'Guides':
- docs-site/concepts/aiax.mdx (~250 LOC) — what AIAX is + composition with PACT (one-page summary, link to SPEC.md)
- docs-site/guides/aiax-discovery.mdx (~150 LOC) — wget-able agent walkthrough (curl /.well-known/aiax.json → curl a section → call a tool)
- The case-studies/aiax-benchmark.mdx page and api-reference/aiax-mcp.mdx page are Sprint B deliverables. Add the NAV ENTRIES in this sprint as 'Coming in v0.1' stubs, but DO NOT author them here.

### F. Kognai mirror coordination (resolves founder-decision §4)

- Open a tracking issue (or note in PR description) requesting Kognai swarm to add `kognai.ai/aiax-reference/invoica/` as a 301 → invoica.ai/aiax in their Next.js config. Single source of truth lives on invoica side; Kognai mirror is signal-only.
- Do NOT block PR merge on the Kognai-side redirect landing. This is a downstream join point.

## Coexistence rule (CRITICAL)

Do NOT touch backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts. It is the existing stdio MCP server for Claude Desktop (different transport, different toolset, different auth model). The new HTTP MCP server lands in Sprint B at backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts and they will coexist intentionally. Any PR that consolidates them will be rejected.

## Out of scope (do NOT pull forward)

- backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts (Sprint B)
- backend/src/aiax/tools.ts (Sprint B)
- aiax-mcp.test.ts (Sprint B)

- No DB migrations.

## Cross-repo coordination (resolves founder-decision §5)

The benchmark harness (5 files: 18 LLM calls + ATRR computation + JSON emit) lives in ~/kognai/scripts/aiax-benchmark/ and is on the Kognai swarm's plate (MacGyver). DO NOT wait for it. Benchmark integration is a downstream join point.

## Deliverables

### A. AIAX HTTP MCP server

- backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts (~300 LOC): HTTP-transport MCP server using `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (already in deps). Mounted at POST /aiax/mcp in backend/src/app.ts BEFORE the authenticate middleware (the per-tool auth lives inside the tool handlers).
- backend/src/aiax/tools.ts (~50 LOC per handler, 6 handlers total — keep tools.ts < 400 LOC; if it grows, split by tool):
  - `invoica_create_invoice` → wraps POST /api/x402/invoice (x402 payment header required)
  - `invoica_settle_invoice` → wraps POST /api/x402/settle (x402 + PACT mandate required)
  - `invoica_query_mandate` → wraps the NEW GET /v1/public/mandates/:id from Sprint A (PUBLIC, no auth) — DO NOT wrap the existing API-key gated /v1/mandates/:id
  - `invoica_dispute_open` → wraps POST /v1/mandates/:id/dispute (PACT mandate auth, requires `reason` field — confirmed against shipped routes/mandates.ts in Sprint A re-diff)
  - `invoica_get_pricing` → static read of /aiax/sections/pricing.json (no auth)
  - `invoica_get_trust_signals` → static read of /aiax/sections/trust_signals.json (no auth)
- DO NOT create POST /api/disputes. Reuse the existing POST /v1/mandates/:id/dispute. This is founder-decision §2; any duplicate dispute surface will be rejected.

### B. Coexistence rule (CRITICAL — repeat from Sprint A)

The existing backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts (stdio, Claude Desktop, 174 LOC) and the new backend/src/aiax/mcp-server.ts (HTTP, AIAX) MUST coexist. Different transports, different toolsets, different auth models. DO NOT consolidate them, share types, or refactor them under a common base class. Any PR that touches backend/src/mcp/invoica-mcp-server.ts will be rejected.

### C. Smoke + tests

- backend/src/aiax/__tests__/aiax-mcp.test.ts: in-process boot the MCP server, list tools (assert exactly 6), round-trip `invoica_get_pricing` and `invoica_query_mandate` (using a seeded test mandate id) — both must return spec-shaped responses.
- scripts/aiax-mcp-smoke.ts: CLI smoke that an operator can run against a deployed environment. Lists 6 tools, calls `invoica_get_pricing`, calls `invoica_query_mandate <id>`. Exits non-zero on any failure. Document the command in the PR description.

### D. Benchmark publish surface (Invoica side only)

The Kognai swarm's harness will POST benchmark.json + log archive references when it's done. Invoica side needs the receiving surface ready:

- backend/public/aiax/benchmark.json: ship a placeholder file checked into the repo with `summary.median_atrr: null` and `reproducibility.raw_logs_url: null`. The harness POST will overwrite it (mechanism: gated `POST /aiax/benchmark/publish` admin endpoint, auth via existing admin API key — implement as a new route at backend/src/routes/aiax-benchmark-publish.ts).
- `aiax.benchmark.published` webhook event type: register in the events dispatcher and fire from the benchmark publish endpoint when benchmark.json is replaced. Per the scope doc §3.5, this helps Helixa cite the latest ATRR. NOTE: this surfaces a phantom-events risk per BUG-PHANTOM-WEBHOOKS-20260529-03 in week-120 — ship the event registered AND wired AND fire-on-publish in the same PR; do not register without firing.
- /aiax/benchmark/logs/<ts>/ — out-of-scope for Invoica disk; the publish endpoint stores the S3 URL inside benchmark.json's `reproducibility.raw_logs_url` field, served as a redirect.

### E. Mintlify docs (extends Sprint A's nav stubs to full pages)

- docs-site/case-studies/aiax-benchmark.mdx (~200 LOC) — published ATRR write-up. Author with placeholder numbers and a clear 'updated automatically post-harness-run' note. After Kognai harness ships, the numbers can be merged in by either swarm.
- docs-site/api-reference/aiax-mcp.mdx (~300 LOC) — full MCP tool reference: tool name, wrapped endpoint, auth, request shape, response shape, example for each of the 6 tools.
- Update docs-site/docs.json to convert Sprint A's 'Coming in v0.1' stubs into live pages.

### F. CHANGELOG + claim line (acceptance §7)

- Add an entry to ~/kognai/workspace/godman-protocols/aiax/CHANGELOG.md containing the exact phrase: 'Invoica is the first published AIAX v0.1 conformant implementation.' Date-stamped 2026-05-XX (date of merge). Cross-repo PR — open a separate Kognai-repo PR for this; do NOT block this Invoica PR on its merge.

### G. Out of scope (do NOT pull forward)

- ~/kognai/scripts/aiax-benchmark/* harness files (MacGyver / Satoshi territory — Kognai repo)
- Running the 18 LLM calls to actually compute ATRR (Kognai harness does this)
- Phase 3 announcement / standards-body submission
- Phase 4 rollout to ClinPay, design.kognai.ai
- v0.2 spec items (compact encoding, federation, registry, auth-gated personalization)
- npm publish of @kognai/aiax-bench (post-Phase 3)
- Mainnet anchor or EIP-712 changes (PACT v0.2, separate)
- No DB migrations.

## ATRR threshold — DO NOT TUNE DOWN

The scope doc explicitly warns the plan's 0.95 ATRR prediction is optimistic; expected real range is 0.85-0.90. The publish threshold is 'median_atrr >= 0.80' AND publishable. If the harness produces below 0.80, iterate the surface (rewrite a section, tighten a JSON file, improve a tool description) — DO NOT change the threshold in the acceptance test or in any published artifact. Any PR that lowers the 0.80 floor will be rejected.
